title: Academic tone
description: Use nominalisation and cautious claims for academic writing.

introduction.headline: Write with academic precision
introduction.body: Practise turning verbs into nouns and hedging claims appropriately.
introduction.bodyIt: Pratica a trasformare verbi in nomi e ad attenuare le affermazioni in modo appropriato.
objectives: Use nominalisation for density and formality

vocabulary.example: Nominalisation makes academic writing more compact.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: La nominalizzazione rende la scrittura accademica più compatta.

vocabulary.example: Academic writers often make tentative claims.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Gli autori accademici spesso fanno affermazioni caute.

vocabulary.example: An impersonal style avoids overusing I and we.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Uno stile impersonale evita di usare troppo I e we.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence shows stronger academic tone?
exercises.promptIt: Quale frase mostra un tono più accademico?
options: The analysis suggests a substantial improvement.
I totally think it got way better.
exercises.answer: The analysis suggests a substantial improvement.
exercises.explanation: Suggests and substantial are typical of cautious academic wording.

exercises.prompt: ____ turns verbs into nouns and densifies formal prose.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: ____ turns verbs into nouns and densifies formal prose.
exercises.explanation: Nominalisation is a hallmark of academic register.

review.tip: Rewrite I found that sales rose as The data indicate a rise in sales.
